classes.name: NeoCellPattern
classes.docsText:
An ordered pattern of cell offsets, relative to an origin.
Hand-built patterns preserve order and duplicates; factories order cells nearest first.

members.name: Count
members.docsText: Number of offsets, including any duplicates.

members.name: FourNeighbors
members.docsText: The four edge-adjacent cells, excluding the origin.

members.name: EightNeighbors
members.docsText: The eight surrounding cells, excluding the origin.

members.name: Box
members.docsText: A filled rectangle of offsets. Omitting radiusY uses radiusX on both axes.

value.value: Box radii must be non-negative; got

members.name: Cross
members.docsText: Axis-aligned offsets. Omitting radiusY uses radiusX on both axes.

value.value: Cross radii must be non-negative; got

members.name: Ring
members.docsText: The square ring at the given Chebyshev radius. Zero returns the center.

value.value: Ring radius must be non-negative; got

members.name: Rect
members.docsText: Cells from the origin through size minus one. Both dimensions must be positive.

value.value: Rect size must be positive; got

members.name: Line
members.docsText: Offsets from the origin through length steps in direction. Center excludes only the origin.

value.value: Line length must be non-negative; got

members.name: Contains
members.docsText: Whether the pattern includes the offset.

members.name: Cells
members.docsText: The ordered offsets translated to absolute cells around origin.

members.name: WithCenter
members.docsText: Prepend the origin when it is absent.

members.name: WithoutCenter
members.docsText: Remove every occurrence of the origin.

members.name: Translate
members.docsText: Shift every offset, preserving order and duplicates.

members.name: Union
members.docsText: Combine patterns, retaining each offset once in first-occurrence order.

members.name: Shells
members.docsText:
Square shells firstShell through the rectangle's Chebyshev radius, each clipped to the rectangle.
A shell runs left column, then bottom/top pairs by x, then right column.
